rules.title: ou / ow / au / aw letter patterns
rules.short_explanation: The letters ou and ow often make the sound in house and how, while au and aw often make the sound in course and saw. Some common words are exceptions, such as soup, should, and daughter.
rules.tts_text: Learn common ou, ow, au and aw words as whole patterns.
rules.mnemonic: House and how; course and saw.

examples.text: Our house is near the city park.
How do you get to the airport?
The course starts in September.
We saw a beautiful sunset yesterday.
The mouse ran behind the sofa.
She found her keys in her coat.
The cow is standing near the fence.
The author wrote a book about travel.
She wore a brown dress to the party.
They bought fresh bread at the market.
The lawn needs water in summer.
Our howse is near the city park.
examples.correction: Our house is near the city park.

examples.text: They sat on the grownd.
The corse starts in September.
The baby crauled across the floor.
examples.correction: The baby crawled across the floor.

examples.text: The mous ran behind the sofa.
examples.correction: The mouse ran behind the sofa.

examples.text: I take a shouer every morning.
examples.correction: I take a shower every morning.

examples.text: Dark clawds covered the sky.
The auther wrote a book about travel.
examples.correction: The author wrote a book about travel.

examples.text: He drew a map of the old tawn.
examples.correction: He drew a map of the old town.

examples.text: They baught fresh bread at the market.
examples.correction: They bought fresh bread at the market.

examples.text: The laun needs water in summer.
examples.correction: The lawn needs water in summer.

examples.text: The soup is hot and tasty.
You should take an umbrella.
The daughter is learning to drive.
